flags.name: Punjab
flags.story: The flag of Punjab is the official flag of the Pakistani province of Punjab. It uses the same colours as the national flag of Pakistan, dark green and white.

credit.artist: Coat_of_arms_of_Punjab.svg : * Pk)punjab.gif : Original uploader was Jolle at es.wikipedia

flags.name: Sindh
flags.story: The flag of Sindh is the official flag of the Pakistani province of Sindh. It uses the same colours as the national flag of Pakistan, dark green and white. The emblem of the province representing its major crops forms the centre of the flag with "Government of Sindh" written in Sindhi and Urdu on a crescent.

flags.name: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
flags.story: The Flag of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa is the flag of the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa within Pakistan. The KPK provincial flag shows Jamrud Fort, the guardian of the Khyber Pass and mountains in the back.

credit.artist: Original uploader was Pahari Sahib at en.wikipedia

flags.story: The Flag of Balochistan is the flag of the province of Balochistan within Pakistan. The Balochistan provincial flag shows stylized mountains of the barren province and the principal mode of transport — the camel, also known as the "provincial animal".

flags.name: Bangsamoro
flags.story: The flag of the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao, an autonomous region of the Philippines, is a horizontal tricolor of green, white and red with the yellow seven-pointed star surrounded by a yellow crescent both centered on the white band and a white kris centered on the red band. It was adopted in 2019.

flags.name: Bago Region
flags.story: The flag of Bago Region depicts two golden hamsas, female one sitting on the male's back, on a white circle bordered by green charged at the centre of blue background. The name "Bago Region" (ပဲခူးတိုင်းဒေသကြီး) is written in Burmese above the birds.

flags.name: Bohol
flags.story: The Flag of Bohol is the provincial flag of Bohol, Philippines. It is a vertical triband bearing the three main colors of the Philippine flag. According to the official interpretation of the flag's symbolism, the color blue represents nobility; white, purity; and red, courage.

credit.artist: The original uploader was Zscout370 at English Wikipedia .

flags.name: Rakhine State
flags.story: The flag of Rakhine State in Myanmar is a bicolour of white and red, charged with the Shrivatsa, a historical symbol of Arakan, on a blue disk in the centre. The bicolour of the flag has been adopted by various ethnic-Rakhine organisations and political parties, often with different symbols in the centre.

flags.name: Mon State
flags.story: The flag of Mon State depicts a hamsa in the centre of a red background. The current flag was approved by the Mon State Hluttaw and officially adopted on 8 June 2018.

flags.name: Bukidnon
flags.story: The Flag of Bukidnon is the provincial flag of Bukidnon, Philippines. It is a horizontal triband of white, red and black, charged in the center with a yellow emblem consisting of a spear pointing downward toward the fly, and a shield which itself is charged with the stylized profile of the Kitanglad mountain range.

credit.artist: The original uploader was Ninane at Dutch Wikipedia .

flags.name: Kagoshima Prefecture
flags.story: The flag of Kagoshima Prefecture is a white field charged in the center with a stylized black and red silhouette of the prefecture's topography. The black portion, which resembles an inverted horseshoe, represents the Satsuma and Ōsumi Peninsulas, with a small dent on the right corresponding to Shibushi Bay.

credit.artist: Daejeon Metropolitan Government. Replica (this file) made by User:D6283

flags.name: Okinawa Prefecture
flags.story: The flag of Okinawa Prefecture is a white field charged in the center with the prefectural emblem, which consists of three circles stacked on top of each other. The two inner circles are positioned upwards; the outermost and innermost circles are red and the middle circle is white.
